name: Eternal Hall (1-2)
source: Pathfinder Society Special #3-99: Fate in the Future
description: Time distorts along this hallway, making the air feel like sludge.
disable: DC 17 Thievery check (trained) to disrupt the temporal distortions, or Dispel Magic (1st rank; counteract DC 16) to disperse the temporal energy

offensiveAbilities.name: Time Press
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature enters the hall

Effect Time weighs upon the creature, dealing 2d6+5 bludgeoning damage (DC 17 basic Fortitude save). On a critical failure, the creature is Slowed 1 for 1 round.
